--- ## What does this plugin do? `agy-dart` is a token-saving, cache-watching, and session-rescue plugin built for **Google Antigravity** (also supports DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, and Codex via `--target`). Once installed, it runs quietly in the background — **no new commands to memorize, just chat and code as usual**: ### 1. Combine small steps into fewer turns When the AI needs to search several terms, it runs them in one batch; when it edits multiple files, it edits them together and runs checks in the same step instead of resending your entire chat history turn after turn. ### 2. Block noisy output & read large files smartly If a test run dumps 3,000 lines of logs, the plugin passes only the key failure lines to the AI (e.g., line 42 failed, the other 199 passed) and keeps the full log locally for lookup. On huge code files, it hands over a line-numbered outline first so the AI reads only the lines it needs. ### 3. Monitor cache & keep it warm on demand The plugin keeps the controllable start of each request steady and cuts down repeated reads of unchanged files; actual cache hit rates still depend on how Antigravity builds requests and how the backend caches them (if you use a dynamic rotating proxy, pinning a single exit node is a useful controlled check). Automatic warming and expiry desktop alerts start off; once enabled, the default limit is 1 warm-up per chat until your next message, and both the count and interval can be changed in the panel. ### 4. Right-sidebar dashboard & crash/hang rescue See at a glance how much context space is left, how many minutes until cache expiry, and how much noise has been blocked. With multiple project windows open, if a background chat runs low on context or gets stuck spinning with zero output, a desktop alert names that project and chat — click it to jump right there. If a chat stalls or hits the limit, copy a progress summary in one click and continue in a fresh chat. ### 5. Catch silent background quota burn (Safety Monitor) Antigravity can occasionally re-review long chats in the background and quietly burn through your 5-hour quota or trigger 429 errors. The plugin watches local logs automatically (and keeps history even if a restart wipes the log): when everything is calm it stays collapsed to one quiet line; if a burn burst or quota cliff hits, the panel expands in plain language and gives you a one-click **Pack Progress & New Chat** button to stop the bleed. ### Other built-in features 1. **Keep your place after `/compact`**: Tracks modified files, latest test/build status, and saved reference IDs in the background so the AI picks right back up after compacting. 2. **Local search for long docs & web pages**: Saves multi-thousand-word docs or web pages locally by section and pulls only matching snippets by keyword. 3. **Filter huge logs & tables locally first**: On multi-MB logs, CSVs, or huge JSON dumps, the AI runs a quick local script to summarize (e.g., top 5 failing endpoints) and brings only the answer into chat; big JSON blobs automatically surface error rows. 4. **Workspace map on new chats**: Gives the AI a compact folder layout, script list, and core-file overview as soon as a new chat starts. 5. **Loop warnings**: Shows a UI-only note (never injected into model context) when the AI gets stuck in `edit → fail → revert → fail` cycles. 6. **Secret masking & sensitive-file protection**: Masks API keys and tokens in logs or web pages, blocks accidental reads of `.env` files when configured, and stops untrusted Git configs from running external commands. 7. **Keep tool replies under 8.8 KB**: Antigravity spills tool replies above ~10 KB into a temp file that costs an extra read turn; the plugin stays inside 8.8 KB and shifts leftover space from short passing checks to real error stack traces. 8. **Usage breakdown, inline diagnostic cards & one-click updates**: Inspect how much context goes to file reads, terminal output, or subagents, view 15-turn cache trends, see interactive inline cards when running `ctx_stats` / `ctx_doctor` (with one-click jump pills to open the side panel on Antigravity `v2.35.1+`), update right from the panel top bar, or replay past chats via CLI to estimate cache hits and warming cost. 9. **Plays nicely with your Skills + Skills bloat check**: Your Skills handle workflows while `agy-dart` quietly guards file reads, trims logs, and watches cache underneath; run `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills` to see how much startup context each installed Skill uses. > Antigravity updates frequently — click **Star** at the top right to follow compatibility updates. --- ## How to Install Requires **Node.js 22.16+ (22.x) or Node.js 24+**. Zero third-party packages — the installer checks that Node's built-in SQLite search engine (FTS5 with trigram) is ready. ### Option 1: One-line terminal install (no clone needed) **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.10.0/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.10.0/install.sh | sh ``` ### Option 2: Let Antigravity install it Send this to Antigravity: ```text Clone tag v1.10.0 of https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git to a temp folder, run `node scripts/install.mjs install` (add `--install-rg` on Windows if `rg` is missing), and confirm `doctor` passes. ``` ### Option 3: Clone & install with custom flags ```powershell git clone --branch v1.10.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git cd Antigravity-agy-dart # Windows PowerShell (optional -InstallRg auto-installs ripgrep) .\install.ps1 -InstallRg # macOS / Linux ./install.sh ``` **Other commands:** ```bash node scripts/install.mjs install # Global install (auto-syncs GEMINI_HOME & T3 ACP if present) node scripts/install.mjs install --project /repo/path # Single-project install node scripts/install.mjs doctor # Check install health node scripts/install.mjs uninstall # Uninstall ``` Restart or reload Antigravity after installing and open a new chat. Your own `rules/*.local.md` files are preserved across upgrades. If you previously installed standalone `agy-fast` or `antigravity-plugin-context-mode`, disable the old ones in your plugin list. Saved document indexes and usage history live locally in `~/.agy-dart/context.db` and stay intact on uninstall. To clear the current chat's index before uninstalling, call `ctx_purge` (when the host omits a session ID, this clears unattributed data for the current workspace); pass `scope: "all"` to wipe all projects. Global uninstall also removes installer-tracked Gemini/T3 copies and lists any older untracked copies with a dedicated removal command instead of deleting blindly. --- ## Settings Everyday switches live right in the **agy-dart Context** side panel: - **Auto-Keepalive (off by default)**: Turn it on for the current chat in the panel, or click **Warm 1×** next to the countdown anytime for a single manual ping. Use **Global Warm** to set the default count and schedule (**Auto**, **Fixed 4 / 9 / 15 min**, or **Custom 1–60 min**). Turning warming off for a chat also silences its expiry and limit alerts. > Note: Each warm-up asks the model for a short `OK` reply and uses input tokens (or the full conversation if the cache already expired). - **Desktop alerts (off by default)**: Cache expiry, stalled-chat alerts, and background quota burn alerts (**Burn Alert: OFF/ON**) all start off and can be toggled individually. - **One-click & automatic updates**: Click **Check Update** / **Update Now** in the top bar anytime, or toggle **Auto-Update: OFF/ON** (off by default) for silent same-major upgrades. - **Other panel controls**: Pause protection, clear old local data, and adjust file-size limits directly in the panel. Preset read limits & tool-loading modes via CLI: ```bash node scripts/install.mjs mode host-45k # Default: direct read up to 45 KB code / 128 KB patches, block >16 KB noisy logs node scripts/install.mjs mode balanced-16k # Outline first above 16 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode fast-32k # Raise normal file limit to 32 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode strict-8k # Block above 8 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode no-read-hook # Never block file reads, only trim noisy terminal output node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading fast-eager # Default: 4 fast tools eager, 8 context tools lazy node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy # All 12 tools lazy-loaded node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading eager # All 12 tools eager-loaded ```
Troubleshooting: ide-tools duplicate /required schema error If Antigravity fails during toolbox initialization with `building toolbox: tool "mcp_ide-tools_mcp_agy-dart_fast_apply_edits" advertises an invalid parameter schema ... at '/required': items at 1 and 2 are equal`, the host's `ide-tools` bridge is duplicating `toolSummary` in `/required`. Switch to lazy loading and restart Antigravity: ```bash node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-dart/scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy ``` (Or remove `"tools"` / `"eager": true` under `mcpServers.fast` in `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-dart/mcp_config.json` and restart. See [skills/agy-dart/references/error-playbook.md](skills/agy-dart/references/error-playbook.md) for diagnostics.)

--- ## 这个插件能帮你干什么？ `agy-dart` 是专为 **Google Antigravity** 打造的省额度、保缓存与会话护航插件（也支持通过 `--target` 装到 DeepSeek Harness、Claude Code 和 Codex）。 装好后在后台自动生效，**不用背新命令，平时照常打字聊天就行**： ### 1. 合并零碎操作，少跑冤枉轮次 AI 要搜好几个关键词时一次同时搜完，要改多个文件时一次改完并顺手跑测试，不用把整段聊天记录反复发好几轮。 ### 2. 挡住刷屏废话，大文件先看目录 跑一次测试吐出 3000 行日志，插件只挑关键报错给 AI（比如第 42 行失败，其余 199 个通过），完整原文存本地随时可查。遇到几千行的大代码文件，先免费递上带行号的目录，AI 只挑要改的那几十行去读。 ### 3. 看清缓存状态，按需自动续温 插件会尽量保持每次请求的开头内容稳定，并减少短时间内反复重读没改过的文件；不过实际缓存命中率仍会受 Antigravity 本身和云端服务影响（如果你用了动态换节点的代理，命中率飘忽时可以先固定单一节点对比排查）。自动续温和缓存快到期时的桌面提醒默认关闭；打开后每段对话默认最多自动续 1 次，发新消息重新计数，次数和间隔都可在面板里调。 ### 4. 右侧监控面板与崩溃/卡死抢救 右侧面板一眼看清：上下文还剩多少、缓存还剩几分钟过期、一共挡掉了多少废话。多开项目窗口时，哪个后台窗口快满或一直转圈不出字，右下角弹窗直接标明项目名和对话标题，点一下就能切过去；万一对话真卡死或快爆上限，点一下面板把当前进度打包，贴到新对话就能接着干。 ### 5. 揪出后台“偷烧额度”（安全审查监测） Antigravity 偶尔会在后台反复重审长对话，悄悄把 5 小时额度烧干甚至触发 429 报错。插件会自动盯着本地运行日志（重启软件也不丢账本）：平时没事就安静收成一行不打扰；一旦发现后台正在反复重审或接近额度红线，面板会自动展开用大白话告诉你现在怎么做，点一下「整理进度，换新对话」就能及时换窗止损。 ### 其他贴心小功能 1. **压缩对话（`/compact`）后不断片**：后台自动记着改过哪些文件、最近测试过没过、存了哪些资料，压缩完 AI 直接接着往下做。 2. **长文档与网页存本地按需搜**：几万字的开发文档或网页按章节存进本机，用到哪段按关键词搜哪段，不硬塞进对话。 3. **大日志和大表格先在本地筛完再汇报**：几十 MB 的日志、CSV 或几万行 JSON，AI 先在本地受限脚本执行器（以当前系统用户身份运行，采用环境变量白名单并过滤凭据、封顶输出）跑几行脚本做统计（比如筛出报错最多的 5 个接口），只把结论带回对话；大 JSON 还会自动挑出报错的异常条。 4. **新对话自动附带项目目录**：刚开对话时自动给 AI 一份精简目录、常用脚本和核心文件清单，不用每次从头摸黑找文件。 5. **死循环及时喊停**：AI 连续出现「改代码 → 报错 → 改回去 → 又报错」或原地打转时，在界面弹一条只给你看的提示（不占模型上下文）。 6. **密钥打码与敏感文件防护**：日志和网页里的 API Key、口令自动打码；可挡住 AI 误读 `.env` 等敏感文件，并防止陌生仓库的 Git 配置偷偷执行外部命令。 7. **把单次返回压在 8.8 KB 内**：Antigravity 单次工具返回超过约 10 KB 会转存临时文件、害 AI 多跑一轮去读；插件把返回稳在 8.8 KB 内，还会把简短命令省下的字数匀给真正报错的长堆栈。 8. **面板看账本、聊天内联卡片与一键更新**：右侧面板可看上下文都花在读文件、终端还是子助手上，查看最近 15 轮缓存命中走势，调 `ctx_stats` / `ctx_doctor` 还能直接在聊天里看交互式诊断卡片（Antigravity `v2.35.1+` 支持一键点进右侧面板）；顶栏支持一键检查/自动更新，命令行还能拿历史记录测算缓存和续温成本。 9. **和各类 Skill 放心叠加，还能做体检**：你装的各类 Skill 照常管流程，插件在底层负责防盲读、压日志和保缓存，互不打架；跑一句 `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills`，就能查出本机每个 Skill 开场占了多少额度、有没有把大段资料全堆在主说明里。 > Antigravity 官方更新很勤，点一下右上角 **Star** 方便随时跟进兼容更新。 --- ## 怎么安装 需要先安装 **Node.js 22.16+（22.x）或 24+**。插件零第三方依赖，安装时会自动检查 Node.js 内置的本地搜索数据库（SQLite FTS5 / trigram）是否可用。 ### 方法一：终端一行命令直装（免手动克隆） **Windows（PowerShell）：** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.10.0/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux：** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.10.0/install.sh | sh ``` ### 方法二：直接发给 Antigravity 帮你装 复制下面这句发给 Antigravity 就行： ```text 请将 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git 的 v1.10.0 标签克隆到临时目录，运行其中的 scripts/install.mjs install 完成全局安装并跑 doctor 自检（Windows 如未安装 rg 请同时传 --install-rg）。 ``` ### 方法三：克隆仓库自定义安装 ```powershell git clone --branch v1.10.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git cd Antigravity-agy-dart # Windows PowerShell（加 -InstallRg 可顺手自动安装快速搜索工具 rg） .\install.ps1 -InstallRg # macOS / Linux ./install.sh ``` **常用管理命令：** ```bash node scripts/install.mjs install # 全局安装（本机有 GEMINI_HOME 或 T3 ACP 目录会自动同步） node scripts/install.mjs install --project /项目路径 # 只装到单个项目 node scripts/install.mjs doctor # 检查安装状态 node scripts/install.mjs uninstall # 卸载 ``` 装完重启或刷新一下 Antigravity 窗口，新开对话即生效。升级重装会自动保留你自建的 `rules/*.local.md`；以前单独装过旧版 `agy-fast` 或 `antigravity-plugin-context-mode` 的话，去插件列表把旧的关掉即可。 本机存下来的文档索引和用量记录保存在 `~/.agy-dart/context.db`，卸载插件时不会误删。想清掉当前对话的索引，卸载前让 AI 跑一次 `ctx_purge`（软件没传会话 ID 时会清理当前项目的未归属记录）；想把所有项目的记录一并清干净，带上 `scope: "all"` 即可。全局卸载也会清理安装器记录过的 Gemini / T3 同步副本；遇到早年手动装过、无法确认归属的旧副本时，会列出路径和单独清理命令，不会乱删。 --- ## 设置调节 日常开关全在右侧 **agy-dart Context** 面板里点一下就行： - **自动续温（默认关闭）**：需要时给当前对话打开「自动续温」，也可以随时点倒计时旁的 **「续温 1×」** 手动续一次；想统一设默认次数和间隔，点「全局续温」（支持 **动态估算**、**固定 4 / 9 / 15 分钟** 或 **自定义 1–60 分钟**）。关掉当前窗口的自动续温后，快过期和次数用完都不会再弹窗。 > 说明：每次续温都会让模型回一个 `OK` 并消耗一点输入额度；如果缓存其实已经过期，会重新处理一遍整段历史。 - **桌面弹窗提醒（默认关闭）**：缓存临期、任务卡死、后台偷烧额度（**偷烧弹窗提醒**）的桌面弹窗全默认关闭，按需在面板里单独打开。 - **一键更新 / 自动更新**：顶栏可直接点「检查更新 / 立即更新」原地升级；旁边的 **「自动更新：关/开」** 默认关闭，打开后同大版本新发布会在后台静默升级。 - **其他开关**：暂停保护、清理旧记录、调整文件读取大小上限，都可以在面板里直接改。 也可以用命令切拦截档位和工具加载方式： ```bash node scripts/install.mjs mode host-45k # 默认：普通代码 45 KB、补丁 128 KB 内直读，大日志超 16 KB 拦截 node scripts/install.mjs mode balanced-16k # 超过 16 KB 先看目录挑重点读 node scripts/install.mjs mode fast-32k # 普通文件放宽到 32 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode strict-8k # 超过 8 KB 拦截 node scripts/install.mjs mode no-read-hook # 读文件不拦，只拦终端刷屏大日志 node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading fast-eager # 默认：4 个高频 fast 工具预载，8 个 context 工具按需加载 node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy # 12 个工具全部按需加载 node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading eager # 12 个工具全部预载 ```
遇到 ide-tools 报 /required 重复参数错误怎么办？ 如果部分 Antigravity 版本初始化工具箱时报错 `building toolbox: tool "mcp_ide-tools_mcp_agy-dart_fast_apply_edits" advertises an invalid parameter schema ... at '/required': items at 1 and 2 are equal`，这是宿主桥接层重复追加了必填字段导致的。把工具加载改成按需加载并重启 Antigravity 即可解决： ```bash node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-dart/scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy ``` 更多排错方法见 [skills/agy-dart/references/error-playbook.md](skills/agy-dart/references/error-playbook.md)。

--- ## What does this plugin do? `agy-dart` is a token-saving, cache-watching, and session-rescue plugin built for **Google Antigravity** (also supports DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, and Codex via `--target`). Once installed, it runs quietly in the background — **no new commands to memorize, just chat and code as usual**: ### 1. Combine small steps into fewer turns When the AI needs to search several terms, it runs them in one batch; when it edits multiple files, it edits them together and runs checks in the same step instead of resending your entire chat history turn after turn. ### 2. Block noisy output & read large files smartly If a test run dumps 3,000 lines of logs, the plugin passes only the key failure lines to the AI (e.g., line 42 failed, the other 199 passed) and keeps the full log locally for lookup. On huge code files, it hands over a line-numbered outline first so the AI reads only the lines it needs. ### 3. Monitor cache & keep it warm on demand The plugin keeps the controllable start of each request steady and cuts down repeated reads of unchanged files; actual cache hit rates still depend on how Antigravity builds requests and how the backend caches them (if you use a dynamic rotating proxy, pinning a single exit node is a useful controlled check). Automatic warming and expiry desktop alerts start off; once enabled, the default limit is 1 warm-up per chat until your next message, and both the count and interval can be changed in the panel. ### 4. Right-sidebar dashboard & crash/hang rescue See at a glance how much context space is left, how many minutes until cache expiry, and how much noise has been blocked. With multiple project windows open, if a background chat runs low on context or gets stuck spinning with zero output, a desktop alert names that project and chat — click it to jump right there. If a chat stalls or hits the limit, copy a progress summary in one click and continue in a fresh chat. ### 5. Catch silent background quota burn (Safety Monitor) Antigravity can occasionally re-review long chats in the background and quietly burn through your 5-hour quota or trigger 429 errors. The plugin watches local logs automatically (and keeps history even if a restart wipes the log): when everything is calm it stays collapsed to one quiet line; if a burn burst or quota cliff hits, the panel expands in plain language and gives you a one-click **Pack Progress & New Chat** button to stop the bleed. ### Other built-in features 1. **Keep your place after `/compact`**: Tracks modified files, latest test/build status, and saved reference IDs in the background so the AI picks right back up after compacting. 2. **Local search for long docs & web pages**: Saves multi-thousand-word docs or web pages locally by section and pulls only matching snippets by keyword. 3. **Filter huge logs & tables locally first**: On multi-MB logs, CSVs, or huge JSON dumps, the AI runs a quick local script to summarize (e.g., top 5 failing endpoints) and brings only the answer into chat; big JSON blobs automatically surface error rows. 4. **Workspace map on new chats**: Gives the AI a compact folder layout, script list, and core-file overview as soon as a new chat starts. 5. **Loop warnings**: Shows a UI-only note (never injected into model context) when the AI gets stuck in `edit → fail → revert → fail` cycles. 6. **Secret masking & sensitive-file protection**: Masks API keys and tokens in logs or web pages, blocks accidental reads of `.env` files when configured, and stops untrusted Git configs from running external commands. 7. **Keep tool replies under 8.8 KB**: Antigravity spills tool replies above ~10 KB into a temp file that costs an extra read turn; the plugin stays inside 8.8 KB and shifts leftover space from short passing checks to real error stack traces. 8. **Usage breakdown, inline diagnostic cards & one-click updates**: Inspect how much context goes to file reads, terminal output, or subagents, view 15-turn cache trends, see interactive inline cards when running `ctx_stats` / `ctx_doctor` (with one-click jump pills to open the side panel on Antigravity `v2.35.1+`), update right from the panel top bar, or replay past chats via CLI to estimate cache hits and warming cost. 9. **Plays nicely with your Skills + Skills bloat check**: Your Skills handle workflows while `agy-dart` quietly guards file reads, trims logs, and watches cache underneath; run `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills` to see how much startup context each installed Skill uses. > Antigravity updates frequently — click **Star** at the top right to follow compatibility updates. --- ## How to Install Requires **Node.js 22.16+ (22.x) or Node.js 24+**. Zero third-party packages — the installer checks that Node's built-in SQLite search engine (FTS5 with trigram) is ready. ### Option 1: One-line terminal install (no clone needed) **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.10.0/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.10.0/install.sh | sh ``` ### Option 2: Let Antigravity install it Send this to Antigravity: ```text Clone tag v1.10.0 of https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git to a temp folder, run `node scripts/install.mjs install` (add `--install-rg` on Windows if `rg` is missing), and confirm `doctor` passes. ``` ### Option 3: Clone & install with custom flags ```powershell git clone --branch v1.10.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git cd Antigravity-agy-dart # Windows PowerShell (optional -InstallRg auto-installs ripgrep) .\install.ps1 -InstallRg # macOS / Linux ./install.sh ``` **Other commands:** ```bash node scripts/install.mjs install # Global install (auto-syncs GEMINI_HOME & T3 ACP if present) node scripts/install.mjs install --project /repo/path # Single-project install node scripts/install.mjs doctor # Check install health node scripts/install.mjs uninstall # Uninstall ``` Restart or reload Antigravity after installing and open a new chat. Your own `rules/*.local.md` files are preserved across upgrades. If you previously installed standalone `agy-fast` or `antigravity-plugin-context-mode`, disable the old ones in your plugin list. Saved document indexes and usage history live locally in `~/.agy-dart/context.db` and stay intact on uninstall. To clear the current chat's index before uninstalling, call `ctx_purge` (when the host omits a session ID, this clears unattributed data for the current workspace); pass `scope: "all"` to wipe all projects. Global uninstall also removes installer-tracked Gemini/T3 copies and lists any older untracked copies with a dedicated removal command instead of deleting blindly. --- ## Settings Everyday switches live right in the **agy-dart Context** side panel: - **Auto-Keepalive (off by default)**: Turn it on for the current chat in the panel, or click **Warm 1×** next to the countdown anytime for a single manual ping. Use **Global Warm** to set the default count and schedule (**Auto**, **Fixed 4 / 9 / 15 min**, or **Custom 1–60 min**). Turning warming off for a chat also silences its expiry and limit alerts. > Note: Each warm-up asks the model for a short `OK` reply and uses input tokens (or the full conversation if the cache already expired). - **Desktop alerts (off by default)**: Cache expiry, stalled-chat alerts, and background quota burn alerts (**Burn Alert: OFF/ON**) all start off and can be toggled individually. - **One-click & automatic updates**: Click **Check Update** / **Update Now** in the top bar anytime, or toggle **Auto-Update: OFF/ON** (off by default) for silent same-major upgrades. - **Other panel controls**: Pause protection, clear old local data, and adjust file-size limits directly in the panel.
